title: Built around the way labour compliance consultancies actually work.
description: LabourFlow is designed around the multi-client workflow of labour law consultants — where one team manages compliance, payroll, documents, deadlines and communication for many businesses.

items.title: Consultant-First
items.description: Designed specifically for professionals who manage labour compliance across multiple client companies, rather than for a single company's internal HR team.

items.title: Multi-Client by Design
items.description: Manage client companies, branches, employees, compliance records and documents from one centralized system instead of maintaining separate workflows for every client.

items.title: Built Around Indian Labour Compliance
items.description: Designed around PF, ESI, PT, LWF, minimum wages, gratuity, bonus, factory licences and other Indian labour compliance requirements.

items.title: One Workflow From Client to Filing
items.description: Connect client onboarding, documents, compliance configuration, attendance, payroll, statutory outputs and client reporting in one continuous workflow.

items.title: Less Switching Between Tools
items.description: Bring work currently spread across Excel, WhatsApp, email, physical files and government portals into one connected workspace.

items.title: Client Self-Service
items.description: Give clients their own branded space to upload documents, view compliance status, check deadlines and access reports instead of handling every request manually.

items.title: Built for Team Collaboration
items.description: Assign responsibilities, track deadlines and maintain visibility across consultants, executives and HR staff with role-based access and activity tracking.

items.title: Inspection-Ready by Design
items.description: Keep documents, filings, compliance history and client records organized so your team can quickly prepare when an inspection or government notice arrives.
